walks a directory tree that contains the plane's own `vaults` — every file in it would be printed into the transcript, and none of them is named on this command line. Exclude it — `grep -rn --exclude-dir=.charter …`, `rg --glob '!.charter' …` — or search the path you actually mean. `charter … secret exec --env NAME=<key> -- <cmd>` is how a command gets a value without anyone reading one.
